note: Both sets over-read the repeated "3" and "11" annotations, but Set A binds the junction box correctly (NEMA 3R, on side of house) and keeps module terminal polarities and string values plausible, while Set B fabricates a connection to "INVERTER EQUIPMENT (SEE E-206)" where the sheet reads "TO PLANTER EQUIPMENT (SEE E-206)", mislabels the "11" bonding-jumper symbol as a PV array component label, and truncates values ("SA", "PV ARRAY RAILS"). Set A's main faults are misbinding the U.V. rating to current-carrying cable (note 2 assigns it to cable ties) and turning "3" into quantities/identifiers/connections, plus duplicate and vague claims. Set B does capture the #10G bonding jumper and several series string connections (SA3-3→SA3-4, SA2-21→SA2-22) that A misses, but its invented and truncated claims are more damaging.
